dialogues.jp: 「お？　ありゃ、ことり？」
dialogues.en: "Oh? Is that Kotori?"
dialogues.text: "Oh? Is that Kotori?"

dialogues.jp:
公園の向こうから、ママチャリに乗ったことり
らしき人物が走ってくる。
dialogues.en:
Across the park, I saw someone who looked like Kotori riding
on a Mamachari.
dialogues.text:
Across the park, I saw someone who looked like Kotori riding
on a Mamachari.

dialogues.jp: 「お〜い、ことり」
dialogues.en: "Heyyyy, Kotori."
dialogues.text: "Heyyyy, Kotori."

dialogues.jp:
大きく手を振る。と、スピードが落ち、俺の目
の前できゅっとブレーキが効いた。
dialogues.en:
I gave her a big wave, partly to let her know that she was
on a collision course with me. She slowed her speed, braking
at my front.
dialogues.text:
I gave her a big wave, partly to let her know that she was
on a collision course with me. She slowed her speed, braking
at my front.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「こんにちは、朝倉君」
dialogues.en: "Good afternoon, Asakura-kun!"
dialogues.text: "Good afternoon, Asakura-kun!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「おっす……って、大丈夫？」
dialogues.en: "Aftern... I mean, are you okay?"
dialogues.text: "Aftern... I mean, are you okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……何がです？」
dialogues.en: "...What do you mean?"
dialogues.text: "...What do you mean?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「何か、顔赤いし、目が潤んでるぞ……もしか
　して俺に惚れた？」
dialogues.en:
"Your face is red, and your eyes are watery... were you just
overcome by your love for me?"
dialogues.text:
"Your face is red, and your eyes are watery... were you just
overcome by your love for me?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いくら何でも、唐突過ぎません？」
dialogues.en: "That's a bit sudden, isn't it?"
dialogues.text: "That's a bit sudden, isn't it?"

dialogues.jp: くすくすと笑いながら、ことりが首を傾げる。
dialogues.en: Kotori giggled, tilting her neck to the side.
dialogues.text: Kotori giggled, tilting her neck to the side.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、さっきの俺の勇姿を見て」
dialogues.en:
"It would happen to anyone who would view such a gallant
figure."
dialogues.text:
"It would happen to anyone who would view such a gallant
figure."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「勇姿？」
dialogues.en: "Gallant figure?"
dialogues.text: "Gallant figure?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「大きく手を振ったじゃん。こう」
dialogues.en: "The big wave I gave you just now, you know."
dialogues.text: "The big wave I gave you just now, you know."

dialogues.jp: そう言って、さっきの仕草を実演してみせる。
dialogues.en:
I gave her a repeat performance of my chivalirious
behaviour.
dialogues.text:
I gave her a repeat performance of my chivalirious
behaviour.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……勇姿でも何でもないような」
dialogues.en: "...I don't see quite see the gallantry in that."
dialogues.text: "...I don't see quite see the gallantry in that."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、こう」
dialogues.en: "Then how about this?"
dialogues.text: "Then how about this?"

dialogues.jp: ぶんっ！　ぶんっ！
dialogues.en: Whoosh! Whoosh!
dialogues.text: Whoosh! Whoosh!

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……変わってませんよ、それ」
dialogues.en: "...That's no different."
dialogues.text: "...That's no different."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「せっかく反復横飛びも加えたのに……で、ど
　うしたの？」
dialogues.en:
"Maybe I'd try doing it in another direction... uhm, so what
happened?"
dialogues.text:
"Maybe I'd try doing it in another direction... uhm, so what
happened?"

dialogues.jp: 冗談はともかく、妙に顔が赤いのは確かだ。
dialogues.en:
I was getting embarassed with my overdone motions, so I
decided to stop the jokes.
dialogues.text:
I was getting embarassed with my overdone motions, so I
decided to stop the jokes.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ええと、風邪なんです」
dialogues.en: "Eehh, it's just a common cold."
dialogues.text: "Eehh, it's just a common cold."

dialogues.jp: そう言って、真っ赤な舌をちょろっと出した。
dialogues.en: She stuck her brilliantly red tongue out cheekily.
dialogues.text: She stuck her brilliantly red tongue out cheekily.

dialogues.jp: 「風邪、か。……じゃ、今は……」
dialogues.en: "A cold, huh... then right now, you're..."
dialogues.text: "A cold, huh... then right now, you're..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「はい、薬局に行く途中です。公園を通ると、
　家からショートカットなんですよね」
dialogues.en:
"Yes, I went to buy medicine from the pharmacy. Going
through the park is a shortcut to my home."
dialogues.text:
"Yes, I went to buy medicine from the pharmacy. Going
through the park is a shortcut to my home."

dialogues.jp:
チャラチャラと、何だか子供みたいに、自転車
のベルを鳴らした。
dialogues.en:
She playfully rang her Mamachari's bell a few times, looking
a bit like a child.
dialogues.text:
She playfully rang her Mamachari's bell a few times, looking
a bit like a child.

dialogues.jp:
「なるほどな。それで、ママチャリに乗ってガ
　キ共を蹴散らしている、と」
dialogues.en:
"I see. So that's why you're kicking around on that
Mamachari like a kid."
dialogues.text:
"I see. So that's why you're kicking around on that
Mamachari like a kid."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……どこにも子供なんて居ませんけど」
dialogues.en: "...If there's any kid around..."
dialogues.text: "...If there's any kid around..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「それじゃ、私はもう行きますね。あんまり、
　外に長い間居ると、アレなんで」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, I better be going now. I shouldn't stay outside too
long."
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, I better be going now. I shouldn't stay outside too
long."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、うん、お大事にね」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, okay, take care of yourself."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, okay, take care of yourself."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君も」
dialogues.en: "You too."
dialogues.text: "You too."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.jp:
走り掛けた自転車が止まり、ことりが顔だけを
こちらに向けた。
dialogues.en:
She stopped pedaling for a second, and turned her head back
towards me.
dialogues.text:
She stopped pedaling for a second, and turned her head back
towards me.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「今喋ったから、うつっちゃったかもしれない
　じゃないですか」
dialogues.en:
"You should be careful as well, I hope I didn't spread any
of my germs from talking to you..."
dialogues.text:
"You should be careful as well, I hope I didn't spread any
of my germs from talking to you..."

dialogues.jp:
それじゃ、とそんな言葉を残して、ことりの姿
が小さくなっていく。
dialogues.en:
After she said that, she turned back and continued pedaling,
her figure getting smaller by the second.
dialogues.text:
After she said that, she turned back and continued pedaling,
her figure getting smaller by the second.

dialogues.jp: 「気をつけてな！」
dialogues.en: "Be careful!"
dialogues.text: "Be careful!"

dialogues.jp:
大声を張り上げる。が、届いたのかどうか……
ことりはそのまま走り去ってしまった。
dialogues.en:
I raised my voice. I wonder if she heard me... her pace
didn't change one bit, though.
dialogues.text:
I raised my voice. I wonder if she heard me... her pace
didn't change one bit, though.

dialogues.jp: 「……さて、俺も帰るか」
dialogues.en: "...Guess I should be going too."
dialogues.text: "...Guess I should be going too."

dialogues.jp:
てくてくと、確かに子供の姿もない桜公園を進
んでいく。
dialogues.en: I slowly make my way out of the Sakura Park.
dialogues.text: I slowly make my way out of the Sakura Park.

dialogues.jp: 「風邪……ねえ」
dialogues.en: "A cold... eh."
dialogues.text: "A cold... eh."

dialogues.jp: まあ、何とかは風邪引かないって言うけど。
dialogues.en: And she said she was worried that I would catch it?
dialogues.text: And she said she was worried that I would catch it?

dialogues.jp:
「ことりの風邪だったら移ってもいいかも……
　なんてな」
dialogues.en:
"It would be better if her germs left her for me instead...
heh."
dialogues.text:
"It would be better if her germs left her for me instead...
heh."

dialogues.jp:
冗談はともかく、その“何とか”からはほど遠
いことり。……早く、治ればいいけれど。
dialogues.en:
I sent that joke along with my other thought to the distant
Kotori... get better soon.
dialogues.text:
I sent that joke along with my other thought to the distant
Kotori... get better soon.

dialogues.jp:
そんな願いのこもった呟きが、夕焼けに染まり
だした空気に、そっと流れていった。
dialogues.en:
As I muttered that wish, it disappered into the flow of the
red-dyed sunset.
dialogues.text:
As I muttered that wish, it disappered into the flow of the
red-dyed sunset.

dialogues.jp: 聞こえるはずのない思いが。
dialogues.en: An unhearable thought.
dialogues.text: An unhearable thought.

dialogues.jp: ◆薬はお早めに◆
dialogues.en: ◆Medicine◆
dialogues.text: ◆Medicine◆

dialogues.jp:
薬局に行く途中だということりに出会った。ど
うも、本格的に風邪をひいてしまったらしい。
dialogues.en:
I met Kotori while she was buying medicine from the
pharmarcy. She doesn't really look like she's suffering too
badly though...
dialogues.text:
I met Kotori while she was buying medicine from the
pharmarcy. She doesn't really look like she's suffering too
badly though...

dialogues.jp: 早く、良くなってくれよな。
dialogues.en: Get well soon, regardless.
dialogues.text: Get well soon, regardless.
